verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Perplexity Computer working in its own cloud-hosted sandboxed Linux VM. It drives web browsers, takes webpage screenshots and reaches services through OAuth connectors. Nothing documents it seeing or operating applications on the user's own computer. Browser automation, cloud VM execution and service connectors are adjacent capabilities, not desktop computer-use, and the community-described local 'Portable Computer' harness is not shown to control local apps.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can let the assistant see and operate applications on my computer to complete work
